runtime_mass_rule: Element mass = same-provider water amount_mol * actual IAPWS molar_mass_kg_mol * nominal mass fraction, identically for liquid and vapor. Never replace the EOS molar mass by formula-weight/1000.
qualification: Nominal elemental mass bookkeeping for manufactured tests only; not measured water isotopic composition or an atomic-number conservation certificate across water chemistry. The present chemical reaction must have zero H2O stoichiometry.
uncertainty: Published plus/minus values retained; no probability distribution, covariance or sample-specific isotopic composition inferred. Nominal fractions are not a certified material uncertainty bound.
